description: Searches the business's CRM customers and returns query, count, truncated, and items; the whole customer list is never returned. Each item has id, name, phone, email, language, type, source, and updatedAt. Use it to look up one customer; use neuron_leads or neuron_calls for recent inbound requests. Spam-marked contacts are excluded, results are most recently updated first, at most 25 results are returned, and truncated is true when 25 were found. This Neuron Expert MCP server tool is read-only and reads only the one business whose owner approved the connection and granted read:contacts on the consent screen. Results are JSON objects also returned as text; the limit is 60 requests per minute per connection, and a refused read returns a tool error with a short reason text.

query.description: Required. Part of a customer's name, email address or phone number; 3 to 80 printable characters.

name: neuron_contacts

truncated.description: True when the read stopped at its row cap (500; contact search 25).

title: Search contacts
